abstract: A 26-year-old male presented with a colorectal adenocarcinoma with germ-cell differentiation and an isolated elevation of serum alpha-fetoprotein. He was treated with platinum/etoposide/bleomycin chemotherapy with a decrease in serum alpha-fetoprotein and in the size of the primary tumor. An ongoing tumor-marker response occurred when the patient was switched to concurrent 5-fluorouracil chemotherapy and radiation therapy. The patient underwent a palliative diversion of his rectal cancer 10 months after diagnosis, developed liver metastasis at 12 months, and died 20 months after diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 26歳男性が、胚細胞分化を伴う大腸腺がんと、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の単独上昇を呈して受診した。プラチナ製剤、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を受け、AFPの低下と原発腫瘍の縮小が認められた。治療を5-フルオロウラシルによる化学療法と放射線療法の同時併用に切り替えた後も、腫瘍マーカーの反応は持続した。診断から10か月後に緩和的人工肛門造設術を受け、12か月で肝転移が出現し、診断から20か月後に死亡した。
